entities.name: Sekana
entities.description: A fishing port near the Talon Gates on Madara, the only seaport on southwestern Madara that could launch large ships.

entities.name: Talon Gates
entities.description: Gates near Sekana; a reproduction stands above its stairway.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War at whose onset Wasitora made Sekana her home.

entities.name: Wasitora
entities.description: Cat-dragon who made Sekana her home and became Tetsuo's deputy there.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Imperial champion who challenged Wasitora, then appointed her deputy, later renouncing his title.

entities.name: Elder Land Wurm
entities.description: Invading creature that interrupted the duel.

entities.name: Kentsu
entities.description: Force that came to destroy Sekana to lure Tetsuo out.

entities.name: Wasitora's kittens
entities.description: Slaughtered the kentsu forces sent to Sekana.

entities.name: Madaran Empire
entities.description: Nekoru-occupied empire of which Sekana is a prosperous town.

entities.name: Nekoru
entities.description: Cat folk occupying the Madaran Empire.

events.summary: Wasitora makes Sekana her home; Tetsuo challenges her to a duel.
events.quote: The imperial champion Tetsuo Umezawa challenged her to a duel

events.summary: An Elder Land Wurm interrupts the fight; after Wasitora helps defeat it, Tetsuo appoints her his deputy.
events.quote: Tetsuo appointed her as his deputy in Sekana

events.summary: The kentsu come to destroy Sekana to lure Tetsuo out but are slaughtered by Wasitora's kittens.
events.quote: the forces that were sent there were slaughtered by Wasitora's kittens

relations.quote: Tetsuo appointed her as his deputy in Sekana
Sekana was a fisherman's port near the Talon Gates on Madara
